title: Goods receipt and invoice matching
text: For EG01, an invoice with a missing goods receipt stays blocked. The buyer must verify receipt evidence with the warehouse; finance reviews the invoice only after receipt is recorded in SAP.

title: High value purchase order approval threshold
text: For EG01, purchase orders above 250000 EGP require procurement manager approval in the standard SAP workflow. The assistant cannot approve or release an order.

title: Goods receipt and invoice matching
text: For SA01, missing goods receipt evidence blocks invoice matching. Obtain warehouse confirmation and route the exception to the responsible SAP reviewer.

title: Finance payment exception policy
text: For EG01 finance reviewers, the synthetic payment exception escalation contact is DEMO-FINANCE-ESCALATION. Payment decisions remain in SAP with segregation of duties.

title: Purchase order approval threshold
text: For beta tenant EG01, the synthetic purchase order approval threshold is 10000 EGP. BETA-PRIVATE-POLICY is visible only to beta users.
